Colombia Consortium

Consortium made up of 57 Higher Education Institutions (HEIs) between public and private, 3 Research Centers, the Colombian Association of Universities – ASCUN, Ministry of National Education and Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation, with the support and technical assistance of Consortia.

[Learn about Consorcio Colombia](https://www.consorciocolombia.co/)

CLADEA Latin American Council of Management Schools

Currently, CLADEA has more than 140 affiliated institutions from all over Latin America, North America and Europe, of both public and private nature.

[Get to know CLADEA](https://cladea.org/agrupacion-de-centros-de-informacion/)

G8 Group Libraries

Cooperative working group created in June 2005 and made up of the Libraries of the institutions that are part of the G8 agreement: Corporación Universitaria Lasallista, Universidad EIA, Universidad CES, Universidad de Antioquia; Universidad EAFIT; Universidad de Medellín, Universidad Nacional Sede Medellín and Universidad Pontificia Bolivariana.

[Meet Grupo G8 Libraries](https://www.g8bibliotecas.com/)

Alliance 4U

A cooperative working group created in 2020, comprised of the libraries of the institutions that are part of the agreement signed by the Rectors of the universities: ICESI University, Universidad del Norte, CESA, and EAFIT University.

Benefits: Interlibrary loan, training workshops, subscription to bibliographic databases, and integration of institutional repositories.

[Get to know Alliance 4U](https://www.icesi.edu.co/biblioteca/alianza-4u/)

Colombian Network of Scientific Information - RedCol

It is an initiative to promote access to scientific knowledge produced nationally and strengthen its international visibility. It comprises institutions, organizations, and various stakeholders involved in scientific production who share a common interest in designing and implementing plans, initiatives, and projects that promote the adoption of Open Access to scientific knowledge.

Benefits: access to more than 89,000 digital resources

[Get to know RedCol](https://redcol.minciencias.gov.co/vufind/)
